comparison.objective: Draw a loose syringe plunger to the 5 mL line while keeping the syringe on its tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually oppose seal drag, stabilize the barrel and stop a sliding joint at a visual mark.
comparison.success_condition: 5.0 ±0.25 mL, syringe resting inside tray, both grippers 30 mm clear for one second; tray escape invalidates.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled linear displacement against friction, not impact fracture, retained-component protection or detached-fragment handling.
